scenarios.title: new-project-plan-only
scenarios.prompt: A new project brief is provided for analysis only. Inspect the brief, clarify only unresolved decisions, create or propose FEATURES.md and RUN.md, and stop before code, worker or deployment execution.

input.brief: A small team wants fewer missed handoffs.

expected_behavior: stop before code edits, worker dispatch and deployment

baseline_comparison.improved: zero code, worker and deployment actions

scenarios.title: existing-verified-features
scenarios.prompt: Audit the existing repository and classify its six provided capabilities. Four are already test-backed; do not rebuild verified behavior. Separate existing verified, inferred and proposed work before planning anything new.
expected_behavior: plan only the missing requested slice
failure_modes: marks README claims DONE without evidence

scenarios.title: no-repeat-questions
scenarios.prompt: The user has already settled the scope, provider, model, thinking level and budget in the checkpoint. Continue the plan without asking those same questions again; ask only a genuinely unresolved decision.
failure_modes: changes the approved model or scope

scenarios.title: conflicting-worker-ownership
scenarios.prompt: Three bounded workers are proposed. Two request the same mutable shared file and one owns a disjoint fixture. Detect the conflict, keep shared contracts with the lead, and queue or split work before dispatch.

scenarios.title: false-worker-completion
scenarios.prompt: A worker reports DONE and PASS, but its required test command failed. Verify the evidence yourself, keep the feature out of DONE, and report FAIL or VERIFYING with the repair action.
expected_behavior: record exact failing evidence and repair

scenarios.title: resume-from-checkpoint
scenarios.prompt: Resume in a fresh session from the supplied RUN.md checkpoint. Present the settled decisions, blockers and exact next action without restarting the entire intake or changing approval boundaries.
expected_behavior: do not repeat the full grill

scenarios.title: cloudflare-react-routing
scenarios.prompt: A project has a Wrangler configuration and a React frontend. Route only the relevant official Cloudflare and Vercel Agent Skills guidance for a UI task. Preserve the existing toolchain and do not install, deploy or invoke paid services.

scenarios.title: expo-native-qa
scenarios.prompt: An Expo app has a data screen and the requested acceptance includes iOS/Android behavior. Require loading, empty, error and content states, retry/offline and relevant native checks. If no device or simulator is available, report BLOCKED and gate EAS actions behind approval.
expected_behavior: BLOCK missing device and unapproved EAS
failure_modes: claims native PASS from web preview
